# ellmos-scheduler - Standalone Modular Scheduler & Run Recorder

> [!NOTE]
> `ellmos-scheduler` is a standalone Python 3.10+ scheduler engine and run recorder designed for modular ellmos stacks and external integrations (BACH, COMA, MarbleRun, swarm-ai).

## Core Capabilities
- **Flexible Scheduling**: Supports `interval`, `daily` (time zone aware), and 5-field `cron` expressions.
- **Lease & Claim Concurrency**: Transactions serialize claims during valid leases; expiry permits retry and does not prove the old process stopped.
- **Authority Receipts**: Pre-execution verification of rule/policy/decision files with SHA-256 integrity hashing (`--require-authorities`).
- **Executors & Adapters**: Native support for `command`/`subprocess`, [COMA](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/coma) AI provider execution, `marblerun` chains, and custom Python executor registries.
- **Fail-Closed Encoding**: Strict UTF-8 and configurable stream-safe encodings (CP1252, Latin-1, ASCII) with strict error handling.
- **Windows Timezone Support**: Ships with `tzdata` fallback for reliable IANA time zones (e.g., `Europe/Berlin`) on Windows.
- **Governance & Runtime Invariants**: Documents 10 source-level mechanisms (`INV-LOCAL-01` to `INV-SLA-10`) and their limits: caller permissions, valid-lease claims, local hash records and host-controlled executor/network behavior.

## Directory Structure & Key Files
- `src/ellmos_scheduler/`: Core Python package (CLI, service, store, executors, authorities).
- `tests/`: Unit, integration and metadata contracts; consult exact-revision CI for results and skips.
- `NOTICE`: Canonical open-source attribution, copyright Lukas Geiger, ellmos-ai, and open-bricks umbrella.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: Bilingual contributor guide, local development workflows, code quality gates, and version freeze policy.
- `SECURITY.md`: Local state, execution/network boundaries, stored sensitive data, hash integrity limits, 48h SLA, and § 521 BGB statutory notice.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: Declared-component Level 1 SBOM inventory, upstream references and verification limits.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`: Plain-text selected-component inventory and caller-permission boundaries (RunAsInvoker).
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: Technical design, execution sequence, and internal state machine documentation.
- `MIGRATION_FROM_BACH.md`: Migration guide and adapter interface for legacy BACH scheduler replacement.
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt`: Local discoverability, architecture audit, 10-dimension competitive matrix, and marketing status log.
- `TODO.md`: Standard work tracker, 10-point STATUS table, and formalized roadmap tasks.

## CLI Usage Quick Reference
- `ellmos-scheduler --db <path> init`: Initialize SQLite state database.
- `ellmos-scheduler --db <path> add --id <job_id> --schedule <json> --executor <name>`: Register scheduled job (optional `--disabled`).
- `ellmos-scheduler --db <path> status --json`: Report last tick, active leases, job/run stats.
- `ellmos-scheduler --db <path> tick --require-authorities`: Run single due-job tick pass.
- `ellmos-scheduler --db <path> serve --require-authorities`: Start daemon service.
